translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Oapostonus Kkewe Seig me Riiurhai
Jesus a faingi fengaenniir rhooawe seig me riiurhai rhooan kkayeo nge a ngaenneer maemaeweer pwe repwe asiuw aniu aenneew me aecchipwaar tae aeremas kka eweriir mesemesaen semwaai.
Ikkaan iteer oapostonus kkewe seig me riiurhai: mmwan nge Simon (pwan itan Peter) me Andrew we pwiin; James we pwiin John, ikkiwe naiun Zebedee;
Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas me Matthew iwe rhooan iyoiyon tax; James we naiun Alphaeus iwe me Thaddaeus;
Simon, iwe erhai man menat,
me Judas Iscariot, iwe e fangenoa tinnimaen Jesus.
Aar Engaang Rhooawe Seig me Riiurhai
Jesus a fangenoa rhooawe seig me riiurhai nge a ammwir ngaeniir pwe, “Oawsoapw noa noan faniuweer re Gentiles aere noan aepinoamwoor re Samaria.
Nge oawpwe faer noa reer aeremesaen Israel pwe iir minne ra weer sheep kkewe ra mwaenirh noa.
Oawnoa nge oawwa fenaiuw kkepas een, ‘Mweoiu Naaeng a arapeto!’

Oaw aecchipwaar rhooa semwaai, oaw aemenewaar tae manimae, oaw aecchipwaar rhooa kaenepaai iwe me oatowowuur aniu aenneew. Oawwa pwigi minneei me reei nge esooar paniuwan, nge oawpwene noa fang nge esoapw pwan yor paniuwan.
Nge oawsoapw pweipwog eew taeppen senaapiy noan pwoarsaemi;
oawsoapw pwan pweipwog pwetoaw me ssiuwenin mengaagiumi me nokka me yomi. Pwe rhooan engaang ina epwe toowow paniuweer.
“Ngaere oawwa toori eew aepinoamw aere pwugos, oawwa pipiiy iyo e tipaeni epwe aetiwaegaemi, iwe oawwa noa no reen toori aaemi oawpwene siusaengi pwiuneoi we.
Ngaere oawtonong noan eew iimw, oawwa aengaeniir pwe, ‘Oapoas epwe no reemi.’
Aere aeremesaen iimw we re aetiwaegaemi, nigititiw kkepesaen oapoas we aaemi reer. Nge aere rese aetiwaegaemi, nge oawwa pwigi sefaaeniy kkepesaen oapoas we aaemi.
Iwe, aere rhooan eew aepinoamw me aere eew iimw rese aetiwaegaemi aere aiussaening ngaenigaemi, oaw siusaengi pwiuneoi we nge oawwa iurhiugi noa ppweoniun me wooan pirhemi.
Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi pwe noan Raaenin Apwiung nge Deus epwe faayeow re Tyre me Sidon memmweer aeremesaen aepinoamw naan.
Aewwaeiraes Kka Epwe Tooto
“Aiussaening, ngaang ipwene aefengaegaemi wow taeppeer sheep reno neeiir cchon wolves. Nge oawpwe aetipaecchemegaemi taeppen sowufaeng nge oawpwan tipipoas taeppeer doves.
Oawpwan aefaennigaemi pwe imwu eyor aeremas kka repwe torofigaemi nge re paenigaemi nong noan nenien apwiung, nge repwe pwan wirhigaemi me noan wutteer Jews.
Pwe reen minne itaei, minne repwene paenigaemi noa mmweer soamwoon me king, pwe oawpwe aengaeniir me re Gentiles Kkepas Mwamwaai we.
Iwe aere ra isenigaemi nong noa nenien apwiung, oawsoapw pireiir reen meeta oawpwe aepesa me wunuunun aaemi aepesa, pwe petenaen kkepas kka oawpwe aepesa epwe toorigaemi noan oaton naan.
Pwe saapw aaemi minne oaw kkepas, pwe Ngeoniun minna Semaemi minne oawwa aepesa mwaenian.

“Aeremas repwene afangmaei noa pwiir ngaeni maenoa, nge saam repwe pwan feeori taeppen minneen ngaeni naiiur; nge naiiur repwene pwan appaniuwaeni semeer me ineer nge re fangenoa iir pwe repwe noa niir noa.
Oanongeer aeremas nge repwe oapwutaegaemi pwe faaen itaei. Nge iyo na e aetemaegin ngaeni minna oarosan nge epwe menaw.

Iwe, aere re aewwaeiraesigaemi me noan eew aepinoamw, siunoa noan ina eew. Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi, pwe epwe itto mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas nge aaemi oaw sogoppaen moann reen aaemi engaang wooan oanongaen aepinoamwon Israel.
“Esooar erhai aeteei suguun epwe taegias saengi aan sinsei, nge esooar erhai rhooan akkiuneo epwe taegias saengi aan maasta.

Ieei minne erhai aeteei suguun epwe kker tipan aan epwe aeffitaeg ngaeni aan sinsei, nge erhai rhooan akkiuneo epwe kker tipan aan epwe aeffitaeg ngaeni aan maasta. Aere ra aeita ngaeni soamwoonin aeinang we pwe Beelzebul, epwe ifa mwo aenneewan aar repwe faingi ngaeniir oanongeer rhooan aeinang we.
Iyo Sipwe Mesagiu
“Iwe, oawsoapw mesagiiur aeremas. Pwe oanongaen meeta ewop epwene pwae noa, iwe me oanongaen kkepas mwoanomwoan repwene giuneei.
Meeta ngaang iya aengaenigaemi noan rorhappiung, oawpwe aepesatae noan seram. Nge meeta oaw rongorong noan saeningaemi oawpwe aekkepwas aegini noa me wooan wungaen iimw.
Oawsoapw mesagiiur rhooamwu regaen niiy noa oanongaemi, pwe ina resoapw mmwenen niiy noa ngeoniumi. Nge oawpwe faer mesagiu Deus, iwe emmwenen niiy noa oanongaemi me ngeoniumi noan nifierno.
Reen efai rhag checcha nge wa mmwenen chuwaiuw riiurhai nicchok, nge erhai mwo nge ese ppiungiutiw nee ppweon aere Semaemi ese iura.
Iwe nge aaemi, oanongaen aennirhimwemi mwo nge Deus e paengi.
Ina oawsoapw mesag, pwe aaemi ina eyor ipitaemi memmweer towunepeer nicchok!
Pwuwafaai me Oasoarhoawuna Kristus
“Rhooakka re aepesa pwe iir naeyi me neeiir aeremas, ngaang ipwe pwan feeori ngaeniir me weni mmwaen Semaei wooai naaeng.
Nge iyo kena resaep saengiaei me neeiir aeremas, ngaang ipwe pwan saep saengiir me weni mmwaen Semaei wooai naaeng.
Saapw Oapoas pwe Efoarh Saeitan
“Oawsoapw maengiy pwe iya itto pwe ipwe pwigito oapoas wooan soanop. Aapw, ise itto pwe ipwe pwigito oapoas, pwe faer efoarh saeitan.
Pwe ngaang itto ipwe feeoriir aetemwaaen repwe aengimaaw ngaeniir semeer, me aeterhooapwut repwe aengimaaw ngaeniir ineer, pwiuniuwaen naiiur repwene aengimaaw ngaeniir inaen pwiuniuweer;
nge rhooan oapwutoag repwe itto saengi rhag rhooan oamw famini.

“Rhooakka e temoag aerhaengerhaengin semeer me ineer me mmwaei, ese fin repwe no pwe naeyi rhooan kkayeo. Nge rhooakka e temoag aerhaengerhaengin naiiur me mmwaei, ese pwan fin repwe no pwe naeyi rhooan kkayeo.
Iwe, rhooakka rese aiufera aar kurus nge re tapweeito mwiriy, nge ese fin repwe no pwe naeyi rhooan kkayeo.
Nge rhooakkena re maengiy repwe kkemwarh wooan meneweer, epwe ppiung saengiir, nge rhooakkena eppiung saengiir meneweer pwe faaen itaei nge repwe weri sefaaeniy.
Paniuwaenin
“Iyo e aetiwaegaemi, e aetiwaeyaei, nge iyo a aetiwaeyaei, a pwan aetiwa iwe efangeto ngaang.

Iyo a aetiwa erhai profeta pwe iga iiy erhai profeta, epwe yor paniuwaenin me reen minna paniuwaen. Nge iyo a aetiwa erhai aeremas mwamwaai pwe iga iiy erhai aeremas mwamwaai, epwe yor paniuwaenin taeppen erhai aeremas mwamwaai.
Aere erhai a aiuniu ngaeni erhai man sessoan kka rhoaniuwaei eew kkepaen rhaan patapat pwe iga iiy erhai rhoaniuwaei, ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi, iiy epwe yo ngaeni minna paniuwaenin.”

footnotes.text: man menat: erhai mwaaen e fiiow ngaeniir sonotawaen Rome faaen itaen faniuwan.
